_comment: This file is hosted (not shipped as part of the extension) at https://yogesh-bhatttk.github.io/bulk-clean-oauth/oauth-client-metadata.json -- kept here in the repo only as the source of truth for that hosted copy, so a change to the extension's own id (manifest.json's "key") or redirect setup can be pushed there deliberately. See https://github.com/yogesh-bhatttk/bulk-clean-oauth. bluesky-popup.src.js and bluesky-dashboard.src.js reference the hosted URL directly as their client_id.
